summary.result: Rice-based systems have high potential for improving food production through an efficient management of fertilizers.
summary.background: Rice ( Oryza sativa ) is one of the most important food crops of SSA, and its consumption is growing faster than any other commodity in Africa.
summary.method: The opportunities offered by the new concepts, modeling and decision support tools are discussed in a regional strategic approach for better management of fertilizers in the diversified ecologies of rice-based systems.
